title: Linux
tagline: The operating system behind most servers, clouds and big data clusters: from your first command to running and securing a real server, explained story by story with animations and real-world examples.

modules.title: Start here: what is Linux?
modules.summary: Prerequisites refresher, operating systems, the Unix-to-Linux story, distributions, installing Linux (WSL, VM, cloud) and your first commands.

lessons.title: Before you start: computer basics, files, servers and how to use this course
What is an operating system? Kernel, shell and the story of Unix and Linux
Linux distributions explained: Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Arch
Linux vs Unix vs Windows vs macOS, open source and the GPL
Installing Linux: WSL on Windows, VirtualBox, dual boot and a cloud VM
Terminal, console, shell and prompt: your first commands

modules.title: The Linux file system

Absolute and relative paths, ~, . and .. and Tab completion
File types and hidden files: file, stat and ls -la
Getting help: man, --help, info, whatis and apropos

modules.title: Working with files and directories

lessons.title: Creating files and folders: touch, mkdir and rmdir
Copying, moving and syncing: cp, mv and rsync
Deleting safely: rm, rm -r, rm -i, shred and why rm -rf is dangerous
Wildcards and globbing: *, ?, [ ] and brace expansion
Viewing files: cat, tac, less, more, head, tail -f, nl and wc
Everyday utilities: date, cal, bc, seq, sleep, time and watch
Bulk renaming with rename and regular expressions

lessons.title: nano: the beginner-friendly editor
vim basics: modes, moving, editing and saving
vim power use: search and replace, blocks, registers and .vimrc

lessons.title: Standard streams: stdin, stdout, stderr and file descriptors
Redirection: >, >>, <, 2>, 2>&1, /dev/null and here-documents
Pipes and tee: building command pipelines
Chaining commands: ;, &&, ||, exit codes, $( ) and xargs

modules.title: Filters, text processing and regex
modules.summary: The data-crunching toolkit: grep, sort, uniq, cut, tr, diff, sed, awk and regular expressions.

lessons.title: grep: searching inside files
sort, uniq, wc, cut, paste and tr

lessons.title: find: search by name, type, size, time and run -exec
locate, which, whereis and type

lessons.title: Users and groups: UID, GID, /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, id, who, w and last
Managing users: useradd, usermod, userdel, passwd and chage
Managing groups: groupadd, gpasswd and usermod -aG

lessons.title: Reading permissions: rwx for user, group and others
chmod: symbolic and numeric modes (755, 644, 600)

ACLs and file attributes: getfacl, setfacl and chattr

modules.title: Inodes and links

lessons.title: Inodes: how Linux stores a file behind its name
Hard links vs soft (symbolic) links

snap, flatpak and building from source
